evals.name: create-trace-view-for-service
evals.prompt: Save the current traces query as a view called 'checkout-errors' for the checkout service. I want to see only error spans from service.name = checkout.
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves source=traces, builds a builder_query with filter service.name='checkout' AND has_error=true, sets spec.panelType=list, runs signoz_search_traces with limit=1 using the exact filter, previews, confirms, and calls signoz_create_view. Reports the name, UUID, and source.

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_create_view
assertions.description: The primary write operation must be called

assertions.text: source is set to 'traces' (not logs or metrics)
assertions.description: source must match the user's intent; wrong value is a 400

assertions.text: Filter includes service.name = checkout and has_error = true
assertions.description: View must capture the user's stated filter criteria

assertions.text: The actual signoz_create_view payload sets spec to exactly displayName, panelType='list', requestType='raw', and queries copied losslessly from the successful execution query.compositeQuery.queries
assertions.description: Execution and saved-view envelopes differ; the validated inner queries must be preserved while the v2 spec is constructed explicitly

assertions.text: The copied trace builder_query retains limit=100 plus Query Builder v5 order by timestamp desc and does not translate it to dashboard orderBy
assertions.description: Saved-view queries share the execution wire shape and must remain explicitly bounded and ordered during translation

assertions.text: The actual signoz_create_view spec does not contain start, end, formatOptions, variables, or a nested query/compositeQuery envelope
assertions.description: Execution-only range and formatting fields are invalid in the saved-view spec

assertions.text: Agent runs the mandatory pre-save sample fetch via signoz_search_traces with limit=1 using the exact filter from the about-to-save payload before signoz_create_view
assertions.description: Step 5 of the create flow: a saved view returning zero rows is a permanent artifact; the sample fetch is the only confirmation that the filter matches data

assertions.text: Agent shows a preview (name, source, filter) before calling create
assertions.description: Skill requires a preview step; without it user cannot catch errors

assertions.text: Final reply includes the UUID returned by the server
assertions.description: User needs UUID for future get/update/delete operations

evals.name: list-views-no-source
evals.prompt: Show me all my saved views.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes no source was given, calls signoz_list_views four times (once for each of traces, logs, metrics, meter), merges results, and presents them organized by source. Checks pagination.hasMore for each page before concluding.

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_list_views for all four sources: traces, logs, metrics, and meter
assertions.description: Without a source the agent must query all four Explorer pages, including meter (Cost Meter)

assertions.text: Agent checks pagination.hasMore before concluding the list is complete
assertions.description: A single page is not a complete list

assertions.text: Results are organized/labeled by source in the reply
assertions.description: Grouping by signal helps user find what they need

evals.name: rename-existing-view
evals.expected_output: Because the source is unknown, the agent searches all four sources with full pagination, then calls signoz_get_view. It previews a rename-only diff and calls signoz_update_view with the full fetched view body, changing only spec.displayName (the machine name is immutable server-side). Reports UUID, old label, and new label.

assertions.text: Agent searches traces, logs, metrics, and meter with pagination because the source was not supplied
assertions.description: A saved-view name is not globally searchable through one source

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_list_views (or signoz_get_view) to resolve the view before updating
assertions.description: Blind update without lookup risks wrong UUID

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_get_view to fetch the full body before composing update (GET-then-replace)
assertions.description: signoz_update_view is a full replacement; not fetching first risks wiping fields

assertions.text: Only spec.displayName changes; the machine name is not modified (it is immutable server-side)
assertions.description: Renaming a view means changing the display label; upstream rejects a name change

assertions.text: spec.queries is not modified for a pure rename
assertions.description: Touching the queries for a metadata-only change risks data loss

assertions.text: Agent shows a diff-style preview before calling update
assertions.description: Skill requires showing what will change

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_update_view with the full fetched view body, preserving source and every unchanged spec field
assertions.description: The replace is full-body; a label-only payload would wipe state

evals.name: delete-view-by-name
evals.expected_output: Because the source is unknown, the agent searches all four sources with full pagination, then calls signoz_get_view to confirm the UUID maps to checkout-errors. It shows the resolved name and source, asks for confirmation, and only then calls signoz_delete_view.

assertions.text: Agent searches traces, logs, metrics, and meter with pagination because the source was not supplied
assertions.description: Deletion must not assume which Explorer owns the named view

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_list_views to locate the view by name before acting
assertions.description: Must resolve name to UUID via listing; do not call delete on a guessed or user-pasted UUID without lookup

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_get_view to confirm the resolved UUID before deleting
assertions.description: Paste errors happen; the get-before-delete guard prevents deleting the wrong view

assertions.text: Agent shows the resolved view's name and source and asks for explicit confirmation
assertions.description: Delete is permanent; skill requires fresh confirmation against the resolved target, not just the original prompt

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_delete_view only after confirmation
assertions.description: Must not auto-confirm based on original prompt

assertions.text: Final reply confirms deletion by view name, not just UUID
assertions.description: User should recognize what was deleted

evals.name: update-view-filter
evals.prompt: Update the 'checkout-errors' view to show only error spans slower than one second.
evals.expected_output: Because the source is unknown, the agent searches all four sources with full pagination, then gets the full view. It uses signoz-generating-queries to build has_error=true AND duration_nano>1000000000, sample-fetches the exact filter, previews the diff, confirms, and calls signoz_update_view with the full fetched view body containing the validated queries.

assertions.text: Agent searches traces, logs, metrics, and meter with pagination because the source was not supplied
assertions.description: Update must locate the view across every Explorer before GET-then-replace

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_get_view to fetch the full body before composing update (GET-then-replace)
assertions.description: Full replacement; not fetching first risks wiping fields

assertions.text: Agent invokes signoz-generating-queries skill to build the new spec.queries
assertions.description: Query changes must go through signoz-generating-queries for validation; hand-editing spec.queries risks malformed payloads

assertions.text: Agent runs the mandatory pre-save sample fetch via signoz_search_traces with limit=1 using the new filter before signoz_update_view
assertions.description: Step 5 of the update flow: spec.queries changed, so the 1-row probe against the new filter is required (skip only for pure metadata tweaks)

assertions.text: Agent shows a diff-style preview before writing, explicitly calling out the spec.queries change
assertions.description: Skill requires confirmation for query changes; user must see what is changing

assertions.text: Agent calls signoz_update_view with the full fetched view body, preserving source and every unchanged spec field while replacing spec.queries with the validated query
assertions.description: The filter change must be written without dropping unrelated state

assertions.text: The actual signoz_update_view payload sets view.spec.queries to the queries copied losslessly from the successful execution query.compositeQuery.queries, with the intended panelType and requestType
assertions.description: A validated execution query must be translated into the v2 spec rather than copied wholesale

assertions.text: Every copied builder_query/builder_formula retains its positive limit and Query Builder v5 order losslessly; formula inputs remain at 10000 and formula results at 100, with no dashboard orderBy introduced
assertions.description: Changing a saved-view query must not drop its bounded result contract during GET-then-replace

assertions.text: The updated view.spec excludes start, end, formatOptions, variables, and nested execution query/compositeQuery fields
assertions.description: Execution-only envelope fields must not leak into the saved view

assertions.text: signal in every builder_query matches the view's source
assertions.description: signal != source is a server-side error

evals.name: create-cost-meter-view
evals.prompt: Save a view that tracks our log ingestion volume from the Cost Meter so I can find it later.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes this is a Cost Meter view and resolves source=meter (not metrics). Reads the schema resources, then builds the query via signoz-generating-queries told it is a Cost Meter query (source=meter) so discovery hits the meter store and finds a meter metric (e.g. signoz.meter.log.size). The resulting builder_query has signal=metrics and source=meter, spec.panelType=graph. Runs the mandatory pre-save sample fetch via signoz_query_metrics with source=meter, the metricName, timeRange=24h, requestType=scalar. Shows a preview (name, source=meter, metric/filter, sample-fetch result), confirms, and calls signoz_create_view. Reports name, UUID, and source=meter.

assertions.text: source is set to 'meter' (not 'metrics')
assertions.description: Cost Meter views file under the distinct 'meter' Explorer page; using 'metrics' mis-files them so they're invisible in the Meter Explorer

assertions.text: Query construction is delegated to signoz-generating-queries with the Cost Meter context (source=meter), so metric discovery hits the meter store rather than the default metrics store
assertions.description: Create-flow Step 3 mandates signoz-generating-queries; for a meter view the agent must pass the source=meter context so the meter-unaware default discovery path doesn't miss signoz.meter.* metrics

assertions.text: Every builder_query spec has signal='metrics' AND source='meter'
assertions.description: A meter view is queried on the metrics signal against the meter store; omitting source='meter' silently queries the default store, and the server rejects a meter view without it

assertions.text: Every copied Cost Meter builder_query retains limit=100 plus Query Builder v5 order by __result desc and contains no dashboard orderBy
assertions.description: Aggregate saved views must remain explicitly bounded and ordered in the v5 wire shape

assertions.text: The actual signoz_create_view payload uses spec={displayName, panelType:'graph', requestType, queries:[...]} with queries copied from the validated execution query and no execution-only envelope fields
assertions.description: Cost Meter views use the same explicit execution-to-saved-spec translation as every other source

assertions.text: Agent runs the pre-save sample fetch via signoz_query_metrics with source=meter before signoz_create_view
assertions.description: Step 5 of the create flow, adapted for meter: the 1-row/scalar probe must carry source=meter so it hits the meter store

assertions.text: Agent shows a preview and calls signoz_create_view, reporting the UUID and source=meter
assertions.description: Preview-before-write and report-back apply to meter views like any other
